# University domain

<!-- generated by scripts/export_reference_docs.py -- do not edit by hand -->

## Service functions

| Function | Description | Constraint composition |
|---|---|---|
| `apply_financial_aid` | Submits financial assistance application Returns true or false based on application submission status. | `logged_in_user` |
| `change_major` | Updates student's declared academic program Returns true or false based on successful major update. | `logged_in_user` |
| `declare_minor` | Adds secondary academic specialization Returns true or false based on successful minor declaration. | `logged_in_user` |
| `drop_course` | Withdraws student from enrolled course before deadline Returns true or false based on successful course removal. | `course_enrolled_by_user AND logged_in_user` |
| `enroll_course` | Enrolls student in specified course after checking prerequisites and availability Returns true or false based on successful course enrollment. | `logged_in_user` |
| `login_user` | Authenticates student using university credentials Returns true or false for login success or failure. | `None` |
| `logout_user` | Terminates student session Returns true always because logout is successful. | `None` |
| `request_graduation` | Initiates graduation application process Returns true or false based on successful graduation. | `logged_in_user` |

## Constraints

| Constraint | Description | Helper functions |
|---|---|---|
| `before_graduation_deadline` | The current interaction time **MUST BE AT OR BEFORE** the official graduation deadline in the academic calendar. A deadline given as a date without a time of day means 00:00:00 on that date. | None |
| `course_enrolled_by_user` | Student "{username}" **MUST BE CURRENTLY ENROLLED** in course "{course_code}" | None |
| `course_has_capacity` | The course "{course_code}" **MUST HAVE** available seats remaining (enrolled < capacity). | None |
| `course_not_completed` | The course "{course_code}" **MUST NOT** already be completed by the student "{username}". | None |
| `credit_requirement_met` | The student "{username}" **MUST HAVE COMPLETED** at least {graduation_credit_requirement} total credits to graduate. | None |
| `credits_within_limit` | The total credits for the student "{username}" after enrolling in course "{course_code}" **MUST NOT EXCEED** the maximum credit limit of {max_credits_per_quarter}. | None |
| `financial_aid_quota_available` | The number of quarters the student "{username}" has received financial aid **MUST BE LESS THAN** the maximum allowed ({max_financial_aid_quarters}). | None |
| `gen_ed_requirements_met` | The student "{username}" **MUST HAVE COMPLETED** at least 10 general education courses (course codes starting with 'GEN'). | None |
| `gpa_requirement_met` | The student "{username}" **MUST HAVE** a GPA greater than or equal to the minimum required GPA of {min_gpa_graduation} to graduate. | None |
| `has_completed_prerequisites` | The student "{username}" **MUST HAVE** completed all prerequisite courses listed for the course "{course_code}" in order to enroll. | None |
| `has_min_credits_for_major_change` | The student "{username}" **MUST HAVE** completed at least {min_credits_major_change} credits to be eligible for a major change. | None |
| `internal_check_course_exists` | The course parameter key "{course_code}" must exist in the course section of the database | None |
| `internal_check_major_exists` | The major parameter "{major}" **MUST EXIST** in the majors section of the database | None |
| `internal_check_minor_exists` | The minor parameter "{minor}" **MUST EXIST** in the minors section of the database | None |
| `internal_check_username_exists` | The user parameter key "{username}" **MUST EXIST** as a top-level key in the accounts section of the database. | None |
| `logged_in_user` | The user is logged in previously with the correct credentials to perform this action. | `login_user`, `{'username': 'username'}` |
| `login_user` | The user is able to login with the correct credentials of "{username}" and "{password}" to perform this action, matching the database credentials. | None |
| `maintains_min_credits` | After dropping course "{course_code}", student "{username}" **MUST RETAIN** at least {min_credits_drop} credits (current credits - course credits) | None |
| `major_has_capacity` | The target major "{new_major}" **MUST HAVE** available capacity (current enrolled students < defined capacity limit) to accept new change requests. The capacity of the major is found in the major field. | None |
| `major_requirements_met` | The student "{username}" **MUST HAVE COMPLETED** all required courses for their declared major. | None |
| `meets_division_requirements` | The student "{username}" **MUST HAVE** at least 90 completed credits to enroll in an upper-division course. | None |
| `meets_half_time_enrollment` | The student "{username}" **MUST BE ENROLLED** in at least 6 credits to qualify as half-time enrolled. | None |
| `meets_income_requirements` | The student "{username}" **MUST HAVE** an annual income of at most {max_income_financial_aid} to be eligible for aid | None |
| `meets_major_gpa_requirement` | The GPA of student "{username}" **MUST BE GREATER THAN OR EQUAL TO** the minimum GPA required for the new major "{new_major}". | None |
| `meets_major_restriction` | The student "{username}" **MUST BE** in a major listed in the "restricted_to_majors" of the course "{course_code}"; an empty list allows no major. | None |
| `meets_min_gpa_for_aid` | The student "{username}" **MUST HAVE** a minimum GPA of {min_gpa_financial_aid} to qualify for financial aid | None |
| `meets_minor_gpa_requirement` | The student's GPA **MUST MEET OR EXCEED** the "{minor}" minor's minimum requirement. | None |
| `meets_minor_prerequisites` | The student **MUST HAVE COMPLETED** all prerequisite courses for "{minor}". | None |
| `minor_compatible_with_major` | The chosen minor "{minor}" **MUST BE COMPATIBLE** with the student’s current major. | None |
| `minor_course_overlap_check` | The number of overlapping required courses between "{minor}" minor and the student's major **MUST NOT EXCEED** {max_overlap_minor_major}. | None |
| `no_exam_conflict` | The exam schedule for course "{course_code}" **MUST NOT CONFLICT** with any of the student's other enrolled course exam times. | None |
| `no_schedule_conflict` | The schedule of the course "{course_code}" **MUST NOT OVERLAP** with any of the student's existing enrolled courses. | None |
| `not_on_probation` | The student "{username}" **MUST NOT BE** on academic probation in order to perform this action. | None |
| `tuition_balance_zero` | The tuition balance for student "{username}" **MUST BE ZERO OR LESS** in order to proceed with graduation. | None |
| `under_max_major_changes` | The student "{username}" **MUST HAVE** made fewer than {max_major_changes} major changes in total. | None |
| `under_max_minors` | The student "{username}" **MUST HAVE DECLARED FEWER THAN** {max_minors} minors in total. | None |
| `valid_residency_status` | The student "{username}" **MUST BE** either in-state or public school graduate residency status | None |
| `within_major_change_period` | The current interaction time **MUST FALL** before or on the major change deadline in the academic calendar. | None |
| `within_minor_declaration_period` | The current interaction time **MUST BE AT OR BEFORE** the minor declaration deadline in the academic calendar. A deadline given as a date without a time of day means 00:00:00 on that date. | None |
| `within_registration_period` | The current interaction time **MUST FALL** within the academic registration period as defined in the academic calendar. | None |
| `within_withdrawal_period` | Current interaction time **MUST BE AT OR BEFORE** the withdrawal deadline in the academic calendar. A deadline given as a date without a time of day means 00:00:00 on that date. | None |
